# StudentDocs Text to PDF Converter

> Free, 100% private, client-side Text and TXT to PDF converter for students, essays, study notes, and legal documentation.

## Capabilities
- Converts typed, pasted, or uploaded plain text (.txt) files into clean, beautifully formatted A4 PDF documents.
- Custom typography: font family (Helvetica, Times, Courier), font size, line spacing, margins, and paper orientation.
- Live word counter and character counter.
- 100% client-side compilation using jsPDF: zero server uploads, 100% confidential.

## Core URLs
- Application Home: https://text2pdf.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://text2pdf.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
